distance.description: Platform fetches children that are up to 'distance' hops away from parent. Default value is 1.

searchString.description: If set, we only return results whose 'name' _startsWith_ the search string

doNotIncludeParents.description: By default, include parent (depth 0) in the result set.

includeInfo.description: If true, include information about the node ('toInfo')

limit.description: If set, the number of results are limited to value specified. Default value is 2000.

offset.description: If set, the offset is applied when fetching results. Default value is 0.

filterByName.description: If set, we only return results whose 'name' is >= the filter string

title: Defines a spec to fetch descendants using the hierarchy denorm table
name: DescendantsSpec
